card.title: Roll request: {label}
card.targetGmOnly: Target: {character}. No player owns this character, so a Gamemaster rolls.
card.public: Public roll: everyone sees the result.
card.private: Private roll: only {player} and the Gamemasters see the result.
card.privateGm: Private roll: only the Gamemasters see the result.
card.onlyTarget: Only {player} or a Gamemaster can roll.
card.waiting: Rolled by {name}. A Gamemaster confirms the roll as soon as one is online.

notify.notAllowed: You may not make this roll.
notify.rollFailed: The roll could not be made: {reason}
notify.alreadyRolled: This request has already been rolled.
notify.noGamemaster: The roll is in the chat. The request is marked as done as soon as a Gamemaster is online.
notify.completeFailed: The roll request {label} could not be marked as done: {reason}
notify.foreignRoll: {name} rolled for the request {label} without being allowed to. The request stays open.
notify.formulaMismatch: {name} rolled {used} instead of {expected} for the request {label}. The request stays open.
notify.visibilityMismatch: The roll of {name} for the private request {label} was not whispered. The request stays open.
notify.duplicateRoll: {name} rolled again for the request {label}, which was already done. The first roll counts.
